name: Zul'Gurub: a Spider Egg is sealed until its Hatching and no crowd control holds it
contract: Round-8 tester (2026-11-15): players could attack Spider Eggs (14915) before Mar'li (14510) made them hatch.
One egg stands 3 yards north of the hero and one 6 yards north. Before Hatch Eggs (2118115) at 17 s the hero
cannot attack the nearer egg; once it casts Hatching (2118119) the hero can. By the user's decision the egg is
immune to all crowd control: stun, fear, polymorph and silence probes are immune, Shadow Bolt is not. Mar'li
dies mid-cast, her eggs' Hatching breaks, and the out-of-combat egg is sealed again; on the old behaviour every
egg was attackable and could be crowd controlled. Round 10 (user, 2026-11-16): each egg has scale 1.5.
